changelog: 100% Isolation is now the default: the Max preset applies the pure (hard) mask — everything the engine classifies as music is silenced completely, leaving only the human voice

New pure separation path at Max: a hard 115 Hz–9 kHz vocal band, a zero residual floor and a 0.35 logit gate — sustained instruments (organs, drones, unchanging tones) are muted within about 2 seconds

Cover art from the file itself: embedded artwork is extracted (ID3v2 APIC for MP3, FLAC PICTURE, M4A/MP4 covr with moov at the front or the end, OGG METADATA_BLOCK_PICTURE), downscaled to 512 px and shown in the library and Now Playing — built-in artwork when a file has none

Pinned playback notification: a persistent top-bar notification while a song plays — cover thumbnail, title/artist, play/pause, next/previous and a one-tap output switch, powered by a foreground MediaSession service that survives the app being backgrounded

Stable audio on every output: the classic Bluetooth/wired-speaker stutter and cut-outs are fixed at the root — a real AudioFocusRequest with a live focus listener (pause on loss, resume on gain), a partial wake lock during playback and config-change immunity

Audio output routing: Auto / Loudspeaker / Earpiece / Bluetooth / Wired — the same selector in Settings and in the notification, with automatic fallback to the loudspeaker when Bluetooth or the jack drops

Bluetooth and headset state tracking: A2DP connect/disconnect, headset plug/unplug and noisy-cable events are handled by dedicated receivers, so a cable yank pauses playback instead of blaring into the room, and a re-plugged headset resumes it
